newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian apartment block collapses, deaths likely.
newsitem.headline: Russian apartment block collapses, deaths likely.

text.p: Part of an old apartment block collapsed in the southern Russian city of Saratov on Monday, probably causing several deaths, officials said.
"There is a great likelihood that people were killed," said an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman in Moscow. A local official in Saratov on the Volga river also said deaths were likely.
A spokesman at the civil defence headquarters in Saratov, about 750 km (470 miles) southeast of Moscow, said by telephone that one section of the building had collapsed at about 11 a.m. (0700 GMT).
The spokesman said the building was old and had five storeys, but did not say how many people lived there. He did not say what had caused the collapse.
"We have only initial information and are checking it out," he added.
Itar-Tass news agency said rescue teams had been rushed to the scene, as well as 10 ambulances.
